positive_global_styles: premium cinematic documentary score, like a high-end film about an endless library of books read aloud by people
felt piano arpeggios, pizzicato strings, soft marimba, warm upright bass, light shaker and soft kick, airy pads
mix leaves plenty of space for a spoken voice-over in the mid range, no lead melody competing with speech

positive_local_styles: soft page-turn intro then a curious piano arpeggio motif
